description: This file defines the LocationInterface, an interface in PHP for location-related models within the Goteo project. It declares methods for retrieving, saving, and validating location objects, as well as permission checks.

classes.name: LocationInterface
classes.description: A PHP interface defining methods for location models, including retrieval, saving, validation, property management, and user permissions.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a location object by its ID.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Static method to obtain the class name of the location model.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Instance method to retrieve the underlying model object.

methods.name: userCanView
methods.description: Checks if a given user has permission to view the location.

methods.name: userCanEdit
methods.description: Checks if a given user has permission to edit the location.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the location data, optionally returning errors.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the location data, optionally returning errors.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property for the location, for a specific user.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value for a location given its ID and property name.
